mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_rooms WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND type = 'MATCH'
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_rooms SET status = 'ENDED', ended_at = #{endedAt}, active_pair_key = NULL WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND type = 'MATCH'
mapper.select: SELECT ph.storage_key FROM post_photos ph JOIN posts p ON p.id = ph.post_id WHERE p.session_date < #{sessionDate}
mapper.delete: DELETE p FROM posts p JOIN (SELECT user_id, MAX(session_date) AS latest FROM posts GROUP BY user_id) t ON t.user_id = p.user_id WHERE p.session_date < #{sessionDate} AND p.session_date < t.latest
mapper.select: SELECT m.id FROM chat_messages m JOIN chat_rooms r ON r.id = m.room_id WHERE m.created_at < CASE WHEN r.type = 'FRIEND' THEN #{friendBefore} ELSE #{matchBefore} END ORDER BY m.created_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_messages WHERE id IN #{id}
